default_polar_canon.description: Canonical Mercury includes polar water niche; default landing/access sortie is a polar settlement per kT. NOT a claim every settlement is permanently shadowed.

default_polar_thermal_load.source: Local landing-site shadow, surface radiation and actual polar infrastructure unprovided
default_polar_thermal_load.description: Do not impose dayside thermal kit or ungrounded polar temperature on default.

surface_temperature_K.description: Illustrative 650–705K insolation sensitivity bracket derived from ESA's maximum ~430°C upper bound; source does not establish uniform lower 650K threshold. Non-gate.

thermal_kit_mass_t.source: No Mercury dayside entry/habitat thermal kit accepted
thermal_kit_mass_t.description: Report as unqualified sensitivity row, no fabricated mass or gate change.

dayside_sensitivity.note: High insolation and hot surface may impose dayside thermal structure, radiator and shelter loads; this comparison never changes polar gate fractions.

thrust_to_weight.source: kT APPROVED Stage3 PR #458 correction 2026-11-03, NONCANON
thrust_to_weight.description: Required world-specific peak belly thrust = T/W × initial loaded landing/ascent mass × local surface gravity; mechanical sizing result, NOT installed thrust qualification.

sortie_dv_kmps.source: kT APPROVED Stage3 PR #458 correction 2026-11-03, NONCANON
sortie_dv_kmps.description: Total combined belly touchdown + hover + lift to torch pitch-up, once per sortie. Do not apply same debit multiple times.

ve_kmps.source: kT APPROVED Stage3 PR #458 correction 2026-11-03, NONCANON
ve_kmps.description: High exhaust speed for thermal/electric water belly; separate from 2226 high-mode main torch.

jet_efficiency.source: kT APPROVED Stage3 PR #458 correction 2026-11-03, NONCANON
jet_efficiency.description: Electric-to-directed-water-jet efficiency: Pjet=F×ve/2, Pinput=Pjet/eta. Does not establish reactor-to-belly GW tap.

torch_reactor_GW_tap.source: Wayfarer: only 63.36 MW raw burn-only torch tap, 75% conversion; no GW feeder declared
torch_reactor_GW_tap.description: GW-class on-shuttle belly energy from torch-lineage reactor remains unqualified; user explicitly forbids crediting source feasibility in numerical water gate.

peak_GW_tap_qualified.source: kT APPROVED Stage3 PR #458 correction 2026-11-03, NONCANON
peak_GW_tap_qualified.description: Physical high-power feeder, direct nozzle conversion and 18h duty architecture missing

ve_kmps.description: Conventional H2/O2 effective exhaust speed bracket, compatible with typical high-performance vacuum LOX/LH2; pressure/altitude dependence not modeled.

cryo_tank_t.source: kT APPROVED Stage3 PR #458 correction 2026-11-03, NONCANON
cryo_tank_t.description: Additional onboard LOX/LH2 cryogenic tank + plumbing dry mass, added ONCE to nonkit shuttle core for chemical architecture and docked A2; vessel dry qualifications OPEN.

boiloff_fraction_per_day.source: kT APPROVED Stage3 PR #458 correction 2026-11-03, NONCANON
boiloff_fraction_per_day.description: Loss of combined stoichiometric H2+O2 propellant water-equivalent per elapsed day; user provided range; high, not a NASA-qualified mission loss rate.

storage_days.description: Explicit illustrative zero-to-one-day interval because user gave a per-day loss but no actual transport/storage time; change if itinerary known. Charged to initial water, never ignored.

electrolysis_kWh_per_kg_water.source: kT APPROVED Stage3 PR #458 correction 2026-11-03, NONCANON
electrolysis_kWh_per_kg_water.description: kT requested conservative electrolysis manufacturing budget. Current sources 45–55 kWh/kg H2 -> ~5–6.1 kWh/kg stoichiometric H2O, so NOT verified ONLINE; 13–16 may include cryogenic liquefaction/handling/provision margin, not decomposed.

molecular_water_to_stoich_h2o2.unit: kg combined H2/O2 per kg water
molecular_water_to_stoich_h2o2.description: The available water mass is converted into H2+O2 mass, no duplicated reaction water and propellant inventories.

house_reactors_net_MW.description: 2×50 MW net onboard Wayfarer, consumed to prepare electrolysis propellant before shuttle departure. No shuttle GW belly tap.

electrolysis_plant_and_liquefaction_qual.source: kT APPROVED Stage3 PR #458 correction 2026-11-03, NONCANON
electrolysis_plant_and_liquefaction_qual.description: Available electrical generation does not prove that a high-throughput electrolysis plant/LOX-LH2 liquefier exists; no plant mass charged to shuttle; Wayfarer capacity and storage remain OPEN.

cryo_joint_storage_qualified.source: kT APPROVED Stage3 PR #458 correction 2026-11-03, NONCANON
cryo_joint_storage_qualified.description: Boiloff and 0.3–0.8t tank declared but actual cold-line valves, oxygen compatibility, landing pad duty and vehicle packaging OPEN

belly.orbit_torch_basis: same high-ve torch and ideal circular-speed lower bound as Stage3 first draft; actual full ascent delta-v remains OPEN

sweep_count.description: Deterministic balanced min/mid/max coverage, not probability

top.description: Three strongest variation/margins per computed gate

cautions: A2 core excludes detachable Titan/Venus kit in Wayfarer dock; Titan installed mass includes kit in wet and thrust analysis.
No kit on Moon/Mars/Mercury; crew cold water, reaction water and custody capsule remain distinct.
Necessary ideal-circular-orbit water floor is not full orbital ascent Δv. C_FULL stays OPEN for each world.
Titan atmosphere beyond near surface represented only by explicitly projected scale height; altitude at 60km is model-boundary censoring, not handover proof.
Titan ambient N2 heat feed from reactor is an assumed 2226 thermal conversion; real methane/nitrogen reactivity, exchanger/cold rotor materials and Torch dense atmosphere stay OPEN.
Plume design and surface survival are not certified; G8 B full fit remains OPEN.
Removed abandoned Venus fixed-peak belly-array analogue; World-specific F=T/W×wetmass×gravity at sampled 1.2–1.5 T/W.
Electric water belly requires GW source tap from torch reactor: OPEN; Wayfarer 63.36MW torch tap is burn-only and no GW feeder proved.
H2/O2 uses shared water by electrolysis aboard Wayfarer, with 100MW net declared house-power, cryogenic tank and time-swept boiloff. Plant/liquefier and fill logistics OPEN.
13–16kWh/kg water is conservative kT sizing ASSUMPTION, not a supported ONLINE electrolysis consumption figure.
Mercury polar settlement default supported by Atlas polar water niche; dayside surface thermal only separate uncredited sensitivity.
